description: Foundation (UI-only, no domain logic). Create app-owned AppText/AppTextInput components driven by the FontScale React context, and rewrite src/hooks/useFontScale.tsx to the context-only mechanism (removing the dead monkeypatch/module-override/Fragment-key code). This is the release-safe replacement for the two previously-failed scaling mechanisms. FEAT-002 depends on these components existing. All paths relative to apps/mobile unless absolute.
steps: Read apps/mobile/src/hooks/useFontScale.tsx, apps/mobile/app/_layout.tsx (provider wiring), apps/mobile/src/constants/theme.ts, and apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx (it consumes FONT_SCALES/FONT_SCALE_LABELS/useFontScale and must keep compiling).

Create apps/mobile/src/components/AppText.tsx exporting two forwardRef components: AppText (wraps RN Text) and AppTextInput (wraps RN TextInput). Each calls const { factor } = useFontScale(). Use StyleSheet.flatten(props.style) to read the component's own fontSize; if a numeric fontSize is present build style as [props.style, { fontSize: Math.round(fontSize * factor) }], otherwise pass props.style unchanged (do NOT inject a default fontSize — let RN inheritance/defaults stand). Pass allowFontScaling={false} to the underlying RN component so the OS font setting does not double-scale. Spread remaining props and forward ref. Props types: AppText uses RN TextProps, AppTextInput uses RN TextInputProps; re-export type { TextProps, TextStyle, TextInputProps } from 'react-native' from this file so call sites can import types from here if convenient (optional for callers).

Add a top-of-file comment in AppText.tsx documenting the nested-Text rule: RN applies fontSize only from the outermost styled Text; a nested Text with no own fontSize inherits the parent's already-scaled size. Because AppText scales ONLY a fontSize present in its own style and injects nothing when absent, nested text is scaled exactly once in both cases (child without own fontSize inherits scaled parent; child with own fontSize scales itself once). No double application.

Rewrite apps/mobile/src/hooks/useFontScale.tsx: keep the EXACT public API — export type FontScaleKey; export const FONT_SCALES = { normal:1, grande:1.15, extra:1.3 }; export const FONT_SCALE_LABELS = { normal:'Normal', grande:'Grande', extra:'Extra grande' }; export function FontScaleProvider; export function useFontScale() returning { scale, factor, setScale, loaded }; AsyncStorage key 'fundo360.font_scale.v1'. The provider holds scale state (useState), loads the persisted value on mount, persists on setScale, and computes factor = FONT_SCALES[scale]. Keep the createContext default value { scale:'normal', factor:1, setScale:()=>{}, loaded:false } so useFontScale outside a provider (AnimatedSplash, OfflineBanner) returns factor 1.

DELETE from useFontScale.tsx: makeScaledComponent, wrapModuleDefault, installFontScaleOverride, the installed flag, factorRef, every require('react-native/Libraries/...') call and its try/catch + eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports lines, the import of StyleSheet from 'react-native' (no longer needed), and the <React.Fragment key={`fs-${scale}`}> remount wrapper (render children directly inside the Provider).
Do not modify app/_layout.tsx — FontScaleProvider usage there is unchanged and still correct.
acceptance_criteria: apps/mobile/src/components/AppText.tsx exists and exports AppText and AppTextInput as forwardRef components that read useFontScale().factor and set allowFontScaling={false} on the underlying RN Text/TextInput.
AppText/AppTextInput apply a scaled fontSize only when the component's own flattened style has a numeric fontSize; otherwise they pass style through unchanged.

useFontScale.tsx keeps the identical public API (FontScaleKey, FONT_SCALES values {normal:1,grande:1.15,extra:1.3}, FONT_SCALE_LABELS values {Normal,Grande,Extra grande}, FontScaleProvider, useFontScale -> {scale,factor,setScale,loaded}, storage key 'fundo360.font_scale.v1') and contains NO require() of react-native internals, no module .default mutation, no makeScaledComponent/wrapModuleDefault/installFontScaleOverride, and no Fragment key remount.
profile.tsx still type-checks against the unchanged useFontScale exports.
verification: From apps/mobile: npm run lint reports 0 errors (pre-existing 'any' warnings OK) and no remaining @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports disable comments in useFontScale.tsx.

From apps/mobile: grep -n for 'Libraries/Text/Text', 'Libraries/Components/TextInput', 'makeScaledComponent', 'wrapModuleDefault', 'installFontScaleOverride', '__fontScaleWrapped' in src/hooks/useFontScale.tsx returns nothing.
findings:
For FEAT-002 (screen migration):
- New file: apps/mobile/src/components/AppText.tsx. Exports (named, no default): `AppText`, `AppTextInput`. Both are React.forwardRef components with matching RN prop types (AppText: TextProps, AppTextInput: TextInputProps).
- Also re-exports types from the same file: `export type { TextProps, TextStyle, TextInputProps } from 'react-native'`. Call sites MAY import these from AppText for convenience, but it is optional (importing from 'react-native' is equivalent).
- Import path from screens: screens live in apps/mobile/app/** and import existing utils as e.g. '../../src/constants/theme'. From app/(tabs)/*.tsx or app/admin/*.tsx the path is '../../src/components/AppText'. From app/*.tsx (login.tsx, change-password.tsx) it is '../src/components/AppText'. From other components in src/components it is './AppText'; from src/components/form it is '../AppText'.
- Migration rule: replace `import { Text, TextInput } from 'react-native'` usages with AppText/AppTextInput. Keep StyleSheet fontSize values as the DESIGN size (do NOT pre-multiply) — AppText scales its own numeric fontSize by the context factor at render time.
- Nested-Text behavior: AppText scales ONLY a numeric fontSize present in its own flattened style and injects nothing when absent. A nested AppText without its own fontSize inherits the parent's already-scaled size (scaled once). A nested AppText with its own fontSize scales itself once. No double application. Safe to nest AppText inside AppText.
- allowFontScaling={false} is already set internally; do not add it at call sites (and do not override it to true, that would double-scale with the OS setting).
- API nuance: useFontScale() returns { scale, factor, setScale, loaded }. The context default (outside a provider) returns factor 1, so components rendered outside FontScaleProvider (AnimatedSplash, OfflineBanner) render at factor 1 safely.
- Env note: `npx tsc --noEmit` currently reports 6 PRE-EXISTING errors unrelated to this task, from 4 packages not installed on disk in this environment (react-native-gesture-handler, expo-sharing, expo-print, @react-navigation/drawer). Confirmed via baseline stash. These are not caused by FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 should not expect to clear them. lint = 0 errors (89 pre-existing warnings).
